gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-106.960317 35.59114)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

WITH study_area_point AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-106.960317, 35.59114), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
aspect_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Aspect(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast, 
        true, 
        study_area_point.geom::geometry
      ), 
      1
    ) AS aspect_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    study_area_point
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, study_area_point.geom::geometry)
)
SELECT 
  ST_Value(aspect_rast, 1, 1) AS aspect_degrees
FROM 
  aspect_raster;
